item: Declaration of interests and activities (déclaration d'intérêts et d'activités)
detail: Macron has filed declarations of interests with the HATVP (as minister in 2014 and as presidential candidate in 2017 and 2022); the 2022 candidate declarations were the first such interest declarations published. The HATVP found his 2014 declaration 'sincere and exact'.

item: Outside paid activities / consultancy while in office
detail: As President, Macron declares no outside paid roles, consultancy, or commercial directorships; the office of President is incompatible with such activities. His declared interests centre on his public functions and past employment.

item: Past professional activities (Inspection des finances, Rothschild, En Marche)
detail: His historical professional interests include the senior civil service, investment banking at Rothschild & Cie, and the founding/leadership of the En Marche! movement. These are past activities, captured in detail in the work-history dataset.
No current corporate board memberships are declared. Any past public-body or governmental roles stem from his official functions, not private directorships.

item: Gifts and hospitality received as head of state
detail: Under French practice, official gifts received by the President in the exercise of his functions are recorded and generally become property of the State rather than personal assets; no personal gifts/hospitality are recorded as declarable private interests. We found no reliably sourced itemised list to include here.
